release_notes: V14.44 build 247 provides compile-corrected, reliable 30-minute chunked Nightscout trend recovery. It maintains one shared 12-hour RAM buffer, retries failed windows, pauses after successive reads to service alarms and the user interface, prevents poorer backfills from replacing better cached history, and rebuilds the 1-hour mini trend from the latest shared-buffer data. It retains deliberate buzzer controls, dual-button forced backfill, factory reset, insulin and carbohydrate history, IOB and COB screens, read-only ketone history, WhatsApp alerts, alarm acknowledgement and OTA protections.
